title: Rebuild and verify the existing chayan chat website

requirements.text: Ensure the existing chayan web chat application is rebuilt and functions end-to-end for a signed-in user: sign in with Internet Identity, discover contacts, start a 1:1 conversation, send an encrypted message, fetch and display/decrypt messages, and use existing privacy controls (delete message, delete conversation, clear local keys).
acceptanceCriteria: When not authenticated, the app shows the sign-in screen and all chat functionality is gated behind login.
After logging in with Internet Identity, the user can search/browse other registered users (excluding themselves) and start a new 1:1 conversation.
Sending a message stores only ciphertext on the backend and the UI displays the decrypted plaintext after fetch.
Message list refreshes via polling (no real-time sockets).
The sender can delete a message and it is removed from future fetches.
The user can delete a conversation and clear local encryption keys using the existing privacy menu without breaking the app.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn components must be composed, not modified).
Do not modify any paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if an actual stable-state migration is required.
nonGoals: Third-party authentication providers other than Internet Identity.
External databases or non-Motoko backend services.
